minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE MEETING
  SPECIAL MINUTES
  June 27, 2019

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, June 27, 2019,
at 2:26 pm in the Council Chambers, 9th Floor.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk 2:17
  Wanda Brown, City Treasurer
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LACO Fire Department
  Lt. David Salcedo, Police Department
  Marissa Fewell, Planning & Building Department

  Staff Present:  Peggy L. Velasquez, Finance Department

Also present were Jerry Tucker, Code Enforcement Manager and Carmen Lopez, Senior
Code Enforcement Officer.

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Item #1:  Councilman George W. Dotson in conjunction with 40 Love Foundation &
  the American Heart Association presents a 5K RUN/WALK at Edward
  Vincent Park, 700 Warren Lane, September 28, 2019 from 7:00 am – 12:00
  pm amplified sound, inflatable jumpers is strictly prohibited and vendors
  cannot sell clothing representing and/or identifies with gang affiliation;
  catering trucks are prohibited from obstructing park walkways; maintain
  event site, no littering and loitering throughout the event, ensuring site is
  properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; ensure safe
  pedestrian and vehicular circulation on/off site; adhere to all applicable IMC
  rules and regulations, including noise and signage.  Motion carried
  unanimously. (Activity No. 00275967)

  There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 2:27 pm.

  Respectfully submitted,

  Peggy L. Velasquez, Recording Secretary
